units.Isaiah 9:1: You people who walk in darkness, behold a great light; you who dwell in a land and shadow of death, a light will shine upon you.
units.Isaiah 9:2: The multitude of the people whom Thou hast brought down in Thy gladness, they will rejoice before Thee, as people rejoice at harvest, and as those who divide the spoils.
units.Isaiah 9:3: For the yoke laid upon them has been taken away, and the rod upon their neck; for the Lord has shattered the rod of their oppressors, as in the day against Midian.
units.Isaiah 9:4: For every robe gathered by deceit, and every garment, they will repay with restitution; and they will wish that they had been burned with fire.
units.Isaiah 9:5: For a child was born to us, a son also was given to us, whose rule was laid upon his shoulder; and his name is called Messenger of Great Counsel. For I will bring peace upon the rulers, peace and health to him.
units.Isaiah 9:6: Great is his rule, and his peace has no limit, upon the throne of David and his kingdom, to establish it and uphold it in righteousness and judgment, from now on and for ever. The zeal of the Lord Sabaoth will do these things.
units.Isaiah 9:7: The Lord sent death against Jacob, and it came upon Israel,
units.Isaiah 9:8: and all Ephraim’s people and those settled in Samaria will know, saying in insolence and a lofty heart,
units.Isaiah 9:9: “Bricks have fallen, but come, let us hew stones, cut down sycamores and cedars, and build ourselves a tower.”
units.Isaiah 9:10: God will dash those rising against Mount Zion upon them, and He will scatter their enemies,
units.Isaiah 9:11: Syria from the sun’s rising and the Greeks from the sun’s setting, who devour Israel with their whole mouth. For all these things the anger did not turn away, but the hand is still high.
units.Isaiah 9:12: The people did not turn back until they were struck, and they did not seek the Lord.
units.Isaiah 9:13: The Lord removed from Israel head and tail, great and small, in one day,
units.Isaiah 9:14: the elder and those who show favoritism—this is the leadership—and the prophet teaching lawless things—this is the tail.
units.Isaiah 9:15: Those blessing this people will lead astray, and they lead astray in order to swallow them up.
units.Isaiah 9:16: Therefore God will not rejoice over their young men, and He will not pity their orphans or widows, because all are lawless and evil, and every mouth speaks unjust things. For all these things the anger did not turn away, but the hand is still high.
units.Isaiah 9:17: Lawlessness will burn like fire and be consumed by fire like dry grass; it will burn in the forest’s thickets and consume together everything around the hills.
units.Isaiah 9:18: Through the fury of the Lord’s anger the whole earth has been burned, and the people will be as though burned by fire. A person will not pity his brother,
units.Isaiah 9:19: but will turn to the right because he will hunger, and eat from the left; a person eating the flesh of his own arm will certainly not be filled.
units.Isaiah 9:20: For Manasseh will eat from Ephraim, and Ephraim from Manasseh, because together they will besiege Judah. For all these things the anger did not turn away, but the hand is still high.
units.Isaiah 10:1: Woe to those writing wickedness! For when they write, they write wickedness,
units.Isaiah 10:2: turning aside the judgment of the poor, seizing the justice of My people’s needy, so that a widow becomes their prey and an orphan their plunder.
units.Isaiah 10:3: What will they do on the day of visitation? For affliction will come to you from far away. To whom will you flee for help, and where will you leave your glory,
units.Isaiah 10:4: so as not to fall into captivity? For all these things the anger did not turn away, but the hand is still high.
units.Isaiah 10:5: Woe to the Assyrians! The rod of My anger and wrath is in their hands.
units.Isaiah 10:6: I will send My anger against a lawless nation, and I will command My people to take spoils and plunder, trample the cities and reduce them to dust.
units.Isaiah 10:7: But he did not consider it this way and has not reckoned it this way in his soul; rather, his mind will turn aside, even to destroy not a few nations.
units.Isaiah 10:8: If they say to him, “You alone are ruler,”
units.Isaiah 10:9: he will say, “Did I not take the country above Babylon and Chalanneh, where the tower was built? I also took Arabia, Damascus and Samaria.
units.Isaiah 10:10: As I took these in my hand, I will also take all the dominions. Wail, carved images in Jerusalem and Samaria!
units.Isaiah 10:11: For as I did to Samaria and her handmade objects, so I will also do to Jerusalem and her idols.”
units.Isaiah 10:12: When the Lord has finished doing all things on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, He will bring judgment upon the great mind—the ruler of the Assyrians—and upon the height of the glory of his eyes.
units.Isaiah 10:13: For he said, “By strength I will act, and by the wisdom of understanding. I will remove nations’ boundaries, plunder their strength and shake inhabited cities.
units.Isaiah 10:14: I will seize the whole inhabited world in my hand like a nest, and lift it like abandoned eggs. There is no one who will escape me or contradict me.”
units.Isaiah 10:15: Will an ax be glorified without the one cutting with it, or a saw be raised without the one drawing it? Likewise, if someone lifts a rod or a piece of wood.
units.Isaiah 10:16: And it will not be so; rather, the Lord Sabaoth will send dishonor against your honor, and against your glory a burning fire will burn.
units.Isaiah 10:17: Israel’s light will become fire, and He will sanctify him in burning fire and consume the woodland like grass. On that day,
units.Isaiah 10:18: the mountains, hills and forests will be extinguished, and it will consume from soul to flesh. The one fleeing will be like someone fleeing from a burning flame.
units.Isaiah 10:19: Those left from them will be a number, and a child will write them down.
units.Isaiah 10:20: On that day Israel’s remainder will no longer continue, and Jacob’s survivors will certainly no longer trust those who wronged them; rather, they will trust God, Israel’s Holy One, in truth,
units.Isaiah 10:21: and Jacob’s remainder will be toward a mighty God.
units.Isaiah 10:22: Even if Israel’s people becomes like the sea’s sand, their remnant will be saved; for He is completing and cutting short a word in righteousness,
units.Isaiah 10:23: because God will carry out a shortened word in the whole inhabited world.
units.Isaiah 10:24: Therefore thus says the Lord Sabaoth: “Do not fear the Assyrians, My people dwelling in Zion, because he will strike you with a rod; for I bring a blow upon you to see Egypt’s way.
units.Isaiah 10:25: For yet a little while, and the wrath will cease, but My anger will be against their counsel.”
units.Isaiah 10:26: God will rouse action against them according to Midian’s blow in a place of affliction, and His anger on the way by the sea, toward the way by Egypt.
units.Isaiah 10:27: On that day his fear will be removed from you and his yoke from your shoulder, and the yoke will be destroyed from your shoulders.
units.Isaiah 10:28: For he will come to the city of Angai, pass into Magedo, and deposit his equipment in Machmas,
units.Isaiah 10:29: cross a ravine and come to Angai. Fear will seize Rama, Saul’s city; she will flee—
units.Isaiah 10:30: Daughter Gallim. Laisa will listen, Anathoth will listen.
units.Isaiah 10:31: Madebena and Gibbir’s residents were distraught. Offer encouragement,
units.Isaiah 10:32: today along the way, to remain; with the hand offer encouragement, the mountain, Daughter Zion, and the hills in Jerusalem.
units.Isaiah 10:33: For behold, the Master, the Lord Sabaoth, throws the glorious ones into confusion with strength; those lofty in insolence will be shattered, and the high brought low,
units.Isaiah 10:34: and the high will fall by a sword, while Lebanon will fall with the high.
units.Isaiah 11:1: And a shoot will come from the root of Jesse, and a blossom will rise from the root.
units.Isaiah 11:2: And the Spirit of God will rest upon him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and godliness.
units.Isaiah 11:3: The spirit of the fear of God will fill him. He will not judge according to appearance, nor reprove according to report;
units.Isaiah 11:4: but he will judge the cause of the lowly, and reprove the lowly of the earth; and he will strike the earth with the word of his mouth, and with breath through his lips he will slay the ungodly.
units.Isaiah 11:5: His loins will be girded with righteousness, and his sides bound with truth.
units.Isaiah 11:6: And the wolf will feed with the lamb, and the leopard will rest with the young goat; and the calf and the bull and the lion will feed together, and a little child will lead them.
units.Isaiah 11:7: And the ox and the bear will feed together, and their young will be together; and the lion and the ox will eat straw together.
units.Isaiah 11:8: And an infant will stretch out his hand over the hole of asps, and over the nest of their young.
units.Isaiah 11:9: And they will certainly do no harm, nor will they be able at all to destroy anyone upon My holy mountain; for the whole earth has been filled with the knowledge of the Lord, as abundant water covers the seas.
units.Isaiah 11:10: On that day there will be Jesse’s root and the one rising to rule nations; nations will hope in him, and his rest will be honor.
units.Isaiah 11:11: On that day the Lord will again show His hand, to be zealous for the remaining remnant of the people left from the Assyrians, Egypt, Babylonia, Ethiopia, the Elamites, the sun’s rising and Arabia.
units.Isaiah 11:12: He will raise a signal to the nations and gather Israel’s lost ones; He will gather Judah’s scattered ones from the earth’s four wings.
units.Isaiah 11:13: Ephraim’s jealousy will be removed, and Judah’s enemies will perish. Ephraim will not envy Judah, and Judah will not afflict Ephraim.
units.Isaiah 11:14: They will fly in foreigners’ ships toward the sea; together they will plunder those from the sun’s rising and Idumea. Upon Moab they will first lay their hands, and Ammon’s sons will be the first to obey.
units.Isaiah 11:15: The Lord will lay Egypt’s sea waste and bring His hand upon the river with a violent wind. He will strike seven ravines so that one may pass through it in sandals.
units.Isaiah 11:16: There will be a passage for My remaining people in Egypt, and it will be for Israel as on the day it came out of Egypt’s land.
units.Isaiah 12:1: On that day you will say, “I will bless Thee, Lord, because Thou wast angry with me, didst turn Thy wrath away and have mercy on me.
units.Isaiah 12:2: Behold, my God, my Savior, is the Lord; I will trust in Him and be saved in Him, and I will not fear, because the Lord is my glory and my praise, and He became my salvation.”
units.Isaiah 12:3: You will draw water with gladness from salvation’s springs.
units.Isaiah 12:4: On that day you will say, “Sing hymns to the Lord, cry out His name, announce His glorious deeds among the nations, remember that His name was exalted.
units.Isaiah 12:5: Sing the Lord’s name, because He has done exalted things; announce these throughout the earth.
units.Isaiah 12:6: Exult and be glad, you who dwell in Zion, because Israel’s Holy One has been exalted in her midst.”
units.Isaiah 13:1: The vision that Isaiah son of Amos saw against Babylon.
units.Isaiah 13:2: Raise a signal on a level mountain, lift your voice to them, do not fear, beckon with the hand: “Open, rulers!”
units.Isaiah 13:3: I command, and I lead them; they are consecrated, and I lead them. Giants are coming to fulfill My wrath, rejoicing and acting insolently together.
units.Isaiah 13:4: A sound of many nations upon the mountains, like many nations; a sound of kings and gathered nations. The Lord Sabaoth has commanded an armed nation,
units.Isaiah 13:5: to come from a distant land, from the farthest edge of heaven’s foundation—the Lord and His armed fighters—to destroy the whole inhabited world.
units.Isaiah 13:6: Wail, for the Lord’s day is near, and shattering will come from God.
units.Isaiah 13:7: Therefore every hand will slacken, and every human soul grow cowardly;
units.Isaiah 13:8: the envoys will be troubled, and labor pains will hold them like those of a woman giving birth. They will lament to one another and be distraught, and change their face as to flame.
units.Isaiah 13:9: For behold, the Lord’s incurable day comes, of wrath and anger, to make the whole inhabited world deserted and destroy its sinners from it.
units.Isaiah 13:10: For heaven’s stars, Orion and all heaven’s array will not give light; it will grow dark as the sun rises, and the moon will not give its light.
units.Isaiah 13:11: I will ordain evils for the whole inhabited world, and for the ungodly their sins; I will destroy the insolence of the lawless and lower the insolence of the proud.
units.Isaiah 13:12: Those left will be more precious than unrefined gold, and a human being more precious than the stone from Souphir.
units.Isaiah 13:13: For heaven will be enraged, and the earth shaken from its foundations through the fury of the Lord Sabaoth’s anger, on the day when His wrath comes upon it.
units.Isaiah 13:14: Those left will be like a fleeing little gazelle and a wandering sheep, with no one to gather them, so that each turns back to his own people and hastens to his own country.
units.Isaiah 13:15: Whoever is captured will be defeated, and those gathered together will fall by a sword.
units.Isaiah 13:16: They will dash their children before them, plunder their houses and take possession of their wives.
units.Isaiah 13:17: Behold, I am rousing the Medes against you, who do not value silver or have need of gold.
units.Isaiah 13:18: They will shatter young men’s arrows and certainly not pity your children; their eyes will not spare the children.
units.Isaiah 13:19: Babylon, which is called glorious by the king of the Chaldeans, will be as when God overturned Sodom and Gomorrah.
units.Isaiah 13:20: She will not be inhabited for everlasting time, nor will people ever enter her through many generations. Arabs will certainly not pass through her, and shepherds will certainly not rest in her.
units.Isaiah 13:21: Wild beasts will rest there, and the houses fill with sound; sirens will rest there, and demons dance there.
units.Isaiah 13:22: Donkey-centaurs will dwell there, and hedgehogs make nests in their houses. It comes quickly and will not delay.
units.Isaiah 14:1: The Lord will pity Jacob and again choose Israel; they will rest upon their land, and the resident foreigner will be added to them and added to Jacob’s house,
units.Isaiah 14:2: and nations will take them and bring them into their place; they will inherit and multiply upon God’s land as male and female slaves. Those who took them captive will be captives, and those who ruled them will be ruled.
units.Isaiah 14:3: On that day God will give you rest from pain, your wrath and the harsh slavery in which you served them,
units.Isaiah 14:4: and you will take up this lament against Babylon’s king and say on that day, “How the one who made demands has rested, and the taskmaster rested!
units.Isaiah 14:5: God shattered the sinners’ yoke, the rulers’ yoke;
units.Isaiah 14:6: having struck a nation in wrath with an incurable blow, striking a nation with a blow of anger that did not spare,
units.Isaiah 14:7: he rested confidently. The whole earth cries out with gladness,
units.Isaiah 14:8: and Lebanon’s trees rejoiced over you, and Lebanon’s cedar: ‘Since you have fallen asleep, the one cutting us has not come up.’
units.Isaiah 14:9: Hades below grew bitter on meeting you. All the giants who ruled the earth rose together for you, those who raised all the nations’ kings from their thrones.
units.Isaiah 14:10: They will all answer and say to you, ‘You too were captured as we were, and were numbered among us.’
units.Isaiah 14:11: Your glory went down to Hades, your abundant gladness. They will spread decay beneath you, and your covering is a worm.
units.Isaiah 14:12: How the dawn-bearer who rises in the morning fell from heaven! The one dispatching to all the nations was shattered to earth.
units.Isaiah 14:13: You said in your mind, ‘I will ascend to heaven, set my throne above heaven’s stars, and sit on a high mountain, upon the high mountains toward the north.
units.Isaiah 14:14: I will ascend above the clouds; I will be like the Most High.’
units.Isaiah 14:15: But now you will descend to Hades and to the earth’s foundations.
units.Isaiah 14:16: Those who see you will marvel at you and say, ‘Is this the person who provoked the earth, shook kings,
units.Isaiah 14:17: who made the whole inhabited world deserted and pulled down the cities, who did not release those in captivity?’
units.Isaiah 14:18: All the nations’ kings fell asleep in honor, each in his own house;
units.Isaiah 14:19: but you will be thrown into the mountains like an abhorred dead man, with many dead pierced by swords, descending to Hades. As a garment stained with blood will not be clean,
units.Isaiah 14:20: so neither will you be clean, because you destroyed My land and killed My people. You will certainly not endure for everlasting time, evil offspring.
units.Isaiah 14:21: Prepare your children to be slaughtered because of your father’s sins, so that they do not rise, inherit the earth and fill the earth with cities.”
units.Isaiah 14:22: “I will rise against them,” says the Lord Sabaoth, “and destroy their name, remnant and offspring”—thus says the Lord—
units.Isaiah 14:23: “and make Babylonia deserted, so that hedgehogs dwell there; she will become nothing. I will make her a muddy abyss for destruction.”
units.Isaiah 14:24: Thus says the Lord Sabaoth: “As I said, so it will be, and as I counseled, so it will endure,
units.Isaiah 14:25: to destroy the Assyrians from My land and from My mountains. They will become a trampling place; their yoke will be removed from them, and their glory removed from the shoulders.”
units.Isaiah 14:26: This is the counsel the Lord has counseled concerning the whole inhabited world, and this the high hand over all the world’s nations.
units.Isaiah 14:27: For what the holy God has counseled, who will scatter? And who will turn back the high hand?
units.Isaiah 14:28: In the year King Achaz died, this utterance came:
units.Isaiah 14:29: “Do not rejoice, all you foreigners, because the yoke of the one striking you was shattered; for from snakes’ seed asp offspring will come, and their offspring will emerge as flying snakes.
units.Isaiah 14:30: The poor will be fed through him, and poor men will rest in peace; but he will destroy your seed with famine and destroy your remnant.
units.Isaiah 14:31: Wail, gates of cities! Let troubled cities cry out, all the foreigners, because smoke comes from the north, and there is no surviving.
units.Isaiah 14:32: What will the nations’ kings answer? That the Lord founded Zion, and through Him the humble among the people will be saved.”
units.Isaiah 15:1: The utterance against Moab’s country. In a night Moab’s country will perish, for in a night the wall of Moab’s country will perish.
units.Isaiah 15:2: Grieve over yourselves, for Debon too will perish. Where your altar is, there you will go up to weep. Over Nabau of Moab’s country, wail: baldness upon every head, every arm cut.
units.Isaiah 15:3: In her squares put on sackcloth and beat yourselves in mourning; upon her roofs and in her lanes all of you wail with weeping.
units.Isaiah 15:4: For Hesebon and Eleale have cried out; their voice was heard as far as Iassa. Therefore Moab’s loins cry out; her soul will know.
units.Isaiah 15:5: Moab’s heart cries within her as far as Segor, for she is a three-year-old heifer. On Louith’s ascent they will go up toward you weeping; along Aroniim’s road destruction and shaking cry out.
units.Isaiah 15:6: Nemrim’s water will be deserted, and her grass cease; for there will be no green grass.
units.Isaiah 15:7: Surely she is not going to be saved even so? For I will bring Arabs upon the ravine, and they will take her.
units.Isaiah 15:8: For the cry has reached Moab’s border at Agallim, and her wailing extends to Ailim’s well.
units.Isaiah 15:9: Remmon’s water will fill with blood; for I will bring Arabs upon Remmon and remove Moab’s offspring, Ariel and Adama’s remainder.
units.Isaiah 16:1: I will send them like creeping creatures upon the earth. Surely Mount Zion is not a deserted rock?
units.Isaiah 16:2: For you will be like a fledgling removed from a bird taking flight, Daughter Moab. Then, Arnon,
units.Isaiah 16:3: take further counsel. Make a shelter of mourning for her continually. In midday darkness they flee; they were distraught. Do not be carried away.
units.Isaiah 16:4: Moab’s fugitives will sojourn with you; they will be a shelter for you from the pursuer, because your alliance was removed, and the ruler trampling the earth perished.
units.Isaiah 16:5: A throne will be set right with mercy, and one will sit upon it with truth in David’s tent, judging, seeking judgment and hastening righteousness.
units.Isaiah 16:6: We heard Moab’s insolence—exceedingly insolent. You raised up your arrogance. Your divination is not so,
units.Isaiah 16:7: not so. Moab will wail, for all in Moab’s country will wail. You will ponder for Deseth’s residents and not be ashamed.
units.Isaiah 16:8: Hesebon’s plains will mourn, and Sebama’s vine. You who devour the nations, trample her vineyards as far as Iazer; you will certainly not reach them. Wander in the wilderness! Those sent out were abandoned, for they crossed the wilderness.
units.Isaiah 16:9: Therefore I will weep like Iazer’s weeping for Sebama’s vine. He felled your trees, Hesebon and Eleale, because I will trample upon your grain harvest and vintage, and all will fall.
units.Isaiah 16:10: Gladness and exultation will be removed from your vineyards; in your vineyards they will certainly not rejoice or tread wine into the vats, for it has ceased.
units.Isaiah 16:11: Therefore my belly will sound like a lyre for Moab, and my inward parts like a wall that you renewed.
units.Isaiah 16:12: It will turn to your shame, because Moab labored at the altars and will enter her handmade objects to pray; it will certainly not be able to rescue him.
units.Isaiah 16:13: This is the utterance the Lord spoke against Moab, whenever He spoke it.
units.Isaiah 16:14: Now I say, “In three years, years of a hired worker, Moab’s glory will be dishonored with all its abundant wealth, and a very small, unhonored remnant will be left.”
units.Matthew 4:12: When He heard that John had been handed over, He withdrew to Galilee.
units.Matthew 4:13: Leaving Nazareth, He came and settled in Capernaum beside the sea, in the territories of Zebulun and Naphtali,
units.Matthew 4:14: so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled:
units.Matthew 4:15: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations:
units.Matthew 4:16: the people sitting in darkness saw a great light, and for those sitting in the region and shadow of death a light rose.”
units.Matthew 4:17: From then on Jesus began to proclaim, “Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.”
units.Luke 2:8: In that same region there were shepherds living in the fields and keeping watch over their flock through the watches of the night.
units.Luke 2:9: An angel of the Lord stood beside them, and the Lord’s glory shone around them; they feared with a great fear.
units.Luke 2:10: The angel said to them, “Do not fear, for behold, I announce to you good news of great joy, which will be for all the people:
units.Luke 2:11: today in David’s city a Savior has been born for you, who is Christ the Lord.
units.Luke 2:12: This is the sign for you: you will find an infant wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.”
units.Luke 2:13: Suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army, praising God and saying,
units.Luke 2:14: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among people of His favour.”
units.Luke 1:30: The angel said to her, “Do not fear, Mary, for you have found grace with God.
units.Luke 1:31: And behold, you will conceive in your womb and bear a Son, and you shall name Him Jesus.
units.Luke 1:32: He will be great and will be called Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
units.Luke 1:33: and He will reign over Jacob’s house forever, and His kingdom will have no end.”
units.Psalms 125:5: Those sowing in tears will reap with exultation.
units.Psalms 125:6: Going, they went and wept, carrying their seeds; but coming, they will arrive with exultation, carrying their sheaves.
units.Psalms 118:161: Twenty-one: Sen. Rulers pursued me without cause, and my heart was afraid of Thy words.
units.Psalms 118:162: I will rejoice in Thy sayings like one who finds much spoil.
units.Psalms 118:163: I hated and abhorred injustice, but I loved Thy law.
units.Judges 7:15: When Gideon heard the dream’s account and its interpretation, he worshiped the Lord. He returned to Israel’s camp and said, “Arise, for the Lord has given Midian’s camp into your hands.”
units.Judges 7:16: He divided the three hundred men into three companies and put horn trumpets into all their hands, and empty water jars with torches inside the jars.
units.Judges 7:17: He said to them, “Look at me and do likewise. Behold, I enter the midst of the camp; as I do, so shall you do.
units.Judges 7:18: When I and all who are with me sound the horn trumpet, you also shall sound the horn trumpets all around the camp and say, ‘For the Lord and for Gideon!’”
units.Judges 7:19: Gideon and the hundred men with him entered a section of the camp as the middle watch began. He thoroughly roused the guards, and they sounded the horn trumpets and dashed the jars in their hands.
units.Judges 7:20: The three companies sounded the horn trumpets and shattered the jars. They grasped the torches in their left hands, with the horn trumpets in their right hands to sound them, and cried, “A sword for the Lord and for Gideon!”
units.Judges 7:21: Each stood by himself around the camp. The whole camp ran; they sounded the alarm and fled.
units.Judges 7:22: The three hundred horn trumpets sounded, and the Lord set each man’s sword against his neighbour throughout the camp. The camp fled as far as Beth-shittah and, gathered together, as far as the edge of Abel-meholah and toward Tabbath.
units.Judges 7:23: The men of Israel cried out from Naphtali, Asher, and all Manasseh, and they pursued Midian.
units.Judges 7:24: Gideon sent messengers throughout Ephraim’s territory, saying, “Go down to meet Midian and seize for yourselves the water as far as Beth-barah, and the Jordan.” All the men of Ephraim cried out, and they seized the water beforehand as far as Beth-barah, and the Jordan.
units.Judges 7:25: They captured Midian’s two rulers, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb in Sourin and Zeeb in Jakephzeeb, and pursued Midian. They brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon from beyond the Jordan.
units.Exodus 22:25: And if you take your neighbour’s garment in pledge, you shall restore it to him before the setting of the sun;
units.Exodus 22:26: for this is his covering, his only garment for his nakedness; What shall he sleep in? If therefore he cries to Me, I will listen to him; for I am merciful.
units.Amos 4:6: “I will give you aching teeth in all your cities and shortage of bread in all your places; yet you did not turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:7: “I withheld rainfall from you three months before the vintage. I will rain on one city but not on another; one portion will be watered, and the portion on which I do not rain will dry up,
units.Amos 4:8: and two or three cities will assemble at one city to drink water, yet they certainly will not be filled; and you did not turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:9: “I struck you with burning and jaundice. You multiplied your gardens; the caterpillar devoured your vineyards, fig orchards and olive groves, yet not even so did you turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:10: “I sent death among you on Egypt’s road and killed your young men with the sword, along with the captivity of your horses. I brought your camps up in fire in My anger; yet not even so did you turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:11: “I overthrew you as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you became like a firebrand snatched from fire. Yet not even so did you turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 6:1: Woe to those who despise Zion and trust in Samaria’s mountain! They harvested the firstfruits of nations and entered themselves. House of Israel,
units.Amos 6:2: all of you cross over and see; pass from there to Emath Rabba, and go down from there to Geth of foreigners, the strongest of all these kingdoms, to see whether their borders are greater than your borders.
units.Amos 6:3: You come toward an evil day, drawing near and touching false sabbaths,
units.Amos 6:4: sleeping upon ivory beds and indulging upon your couches, eating young goats from the flocks and milk-fed calves from the herds,
units.Amos 6:5: clapping to the sound of instruments; they reckoned them as lasting, not passing away,

units.Jeremiah 27:1: The Lord’s word that He spoke against Babylon:
units.Jeremiah 27:2: Announce among the nations and make it heard; do not hide it. Say, Babylon has been captured! Bel was disgraced, the fearless one; the delicate one was handed over, Marodach.
units.Jeremiah 27:3: A nation came up against her from the north; it will make her land a ruin, with no one living in it, from human to livestock.
units.Jeremiah 27:4: In those days and at that time, Israel’s sons and Judah’s sons will come together; walking and weeping, they will go seeking the Lord their God.
units.Jeremiah 27:5: They will ask the way as far as Zion, for they will turn their faces here. They will come and take refuge with the Lord God, for an everlasting covenant will not be forgotten.
units.Jeremiah 27:6: My people became lost sheep; their shepherds thrust them away and led them astray upon the mountains. They went from mountain to hill and forgot their resting place.
units.Jeremiah 27:7: All who found them consumed them. Their enemies said, Let us not release them, because they sinned against the Lord, the pasture of righteousness, who gathered their fathers.
units.Jeremiah 27:8: Separate yourselves from Babylon’s midst and the Chaldeans’ land; come out and become like dragons before sheep.
units.Jeremiah 27:9: I am rousing assemblies of nations against Babylon from the north. They will deploy against her; from there she will be captured. Like a discerning warrior’s missile, it will not return empty.
units.Jeremiah 27:10: Chaldea will become plunder; all who plunder her will be filled.
units.Jeremiah 27:11: because you rejoiced and boasted while plundering My inheritance, because you leaped like little cattle in pasture and butted like bulls,
units.Jeremiah 27:12: your mother was deeply ashamed—a mother for good things, last of nations, a wilderness.
units.Jeremiah 27:13: Because of the Lord’s anger she will not be inhabited and will entirely disappear. Everyone passing through Babylon will look gloomy, and they will hiss at every wound of hers.
units.Jeremiah 27:14: Deploy against Babylon all around, all who stretch the bow. Shoot at her; do not spare your arrows.
units.Jeremiah 27:15: Clap against her! Her hands were disabled, her battlements fell, and her wall was demolished. For this is vengeance from God; take vengeance upon her. Do to her as she did.
units.Jeremiah 27:16: Destroy seed from Babylon, the one holding a sickle at harvest. Before the Greek sword, each will return to his people and flee to his land.
units.Jeremiah 27:17: Israel is a wandering sheep driven away by lions. First Assyria’s king ate him; later this one, Babylon’s king, ate his bones.
units.Jeremiah 27:18: Therefore thus says the Lord: I am taking vengeance upon Babylon’s king and his land, as I took vengeance upon Assyria’s king.
units.Jeremiah 27:19: I will restore Israel to his pasture. He will graze on Carmel, on Ephraim’s mountain, and in Gilead, and his soul will be filled.
units.Jeremiah 27:20: In those days and at that time they will seek Israel’s injustice, and it will not exist, and Judah’s sins, and they certainly will not be found, for I will be merciful to those left upon the land, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 27:21: Go fiercely against her and her inhabitants. Take vengeance, sword, and make her disappear, says the Lord; do everything I command you.
units.Jeremiah 27:22: A sound of war and great shattering in the Chaldeans’ land!
units.Jeremiah 27:23: How the hammer of the whole earth was snapped and shattered! How Babylon became a ruin among nations!
units.Jeremiah 27:24: They will attack you and you will be captured, Babylon, without knowing it. You were found and taken because you resisted the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 27:25: The Lord opened His treasury and brought out the instruments of His anger, for the Lord God has work in the Chaldeans’ land,
units.Jeremiah 27:26: for her times have arrived. Open her storehouses; search her like a cave and destroy her. Let no remnant of her remain.
units.Jeremiah 27:27: Dry up all her fruits, and let them go down to slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come, the time of their vengeance.
units.Jeremiah 27:28: A sound of those fleeing and being rescued from Babylon’s land, announcing in Zion vengeance from the Lord our God!
units.Jeremiah 27:29: Give orders against Babylon to many, to everyone drawing a bow. Encamp against her all around; let none of her people escape. Repay her according to her works; do to her all she did, for she resisted the Lord, Israel’s holy God.
units.Jeremiah 27:30: Therefore her young men will fall in her squares, and all her warriors will be thrown down, said the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 27:31: I am against you, insolent woman, says the Lord, for your day has come, the time of your vengeance.
units.Jeremiah 27:32: Your insolence will grow weak and fall, with no one to raise it. I will kindle fire in her forest, and it will devour everything around her.
units.Jeremiah 27:33: Thus says the Lord: Israel’s sons and Judah’s sons have been oppressed together. All who captured them oppressed them, because they did not want to release them.
units.Jeremiah 27:34: The One redeeming them is strong; the Lord Almighty is His name. He will judge a case against His adversaries, to remove the land, and He will provoke Babylon’s inhabitants.
units.Jeremiah 27:35: A sword against the Chaldeans, Babylon’s inhabitants, her nobles, and her discerning men!
units.Jeremiah 27:36: A sword against her warriors, and they will be disabled!
units.Jeremiah 27:37: A sword against their horses and chariots! A sword against their warriors and the mixed people within her, and they will become like women! A sword against her treasures, and they will be scattered!

units.Jeremiah 27:39: Therefore apparitions will live on the islands, and daughters of sirens will live in her. She certainly will never again be inhabited.
units.Jeremiah 27:40: As God overturned Sodom, Gomorrah, and their bordering places, said the Lord, no person will live there, and no human being will reside there.

units.Jeremiah 27:44: Like a lion he will come up from the Jordan into Aitham’s place, for I will quickly drive them away from her and appoint every young man over her. For who is like Me? Who will resist Me, and what shepherd can stand before Me?

units.Jeremiah 28:1: Thus says the Lord: I am rousing a destroying hot wind against Babylon and against the Chaldeans who live there.
units.Jeremiah 28:2: I will send insolent men to Babylon; they will abuse her and ravage her land. Woe upon Babylon all around on the day of her affliction!
units.Jeremiah 28:3: Against her let the archer stretch his bow, and let the man who has armor put it on. Do not spare her young men; obliterate her whole force.
units.Jeremiah 28:4: Wounded men will fall in the Chaldeans’ land, and pierced men outside her.
units.Jeremiah 28:5: For Israel and Judah have not been widowed of their God, of the Lord Almighty, because their land was filled with injustice from Israel’s holy ones.
units.Jeremiah 28:6: Flee from Babylon’s midst; each of you save your life. Do not be cast away in her injustice, for her time of vengeance is from the Lord; He is repaying her recompense.
units.Jeremiah 28:7: Babylon was a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, making the whole earth drunk. Nations drank her wine; therefore they were shaken.
units.Jeremiah 28:8: Suddenly Babylon fell and was shattered. Lament her! Take resin for her corruption, if somehow she may be healed.
units.Jeremiah 28:9: We treated Babylon, but she was not healed. Let us leave her; let each of us go to our own land, for her judgment reached heaven and rose to the stars.
units.Jeremiah 28:10: The Lord has brought forth His judgment. Come, let us announce in Zion the works of the Lord our God.
units.Jeremiah 28:11: Prepare the arrows; fill the quivers. The Lord roused the spirit of the Medes’ king, for His anger against Babylon is to destroy her. This is the Lord’s vengeance, vengeance for His people.
units.Jeremiah 28:12: Raise a signal on Babylon’s walls; set up quivers, raise guards, prepare weapons, for the Lord has undertaken and will do what He spoke against Babylon’s inhabitants,
units.Jeremiah 28:13: who dwell beside many waters and her abundance of treasures. Your end has truly come to your inward parts.
units.Jeremiah 28:14: For the Lord swore by His arm: I will fill you with people like locusts, and those coming down will speak out against you.
units.Jeremiah 28:15: He makes the earth by His strength, prepares the inhabited world by His wisdom, and stretched out heaven by His understanding.
units.Jeremiah 28:16: At His voice He set a sound of water in heaven and brought clouds up from the earth’s end. He made lightning for rain and brought light out of His treasuries.
units.Jeremiah 28:17: Every person became foolish, without knowledge; every goldsmith was disgraced by his carvings, because they cast false things, and there is no spirit in them.
units.Jeremiah 28:18: They are vain, mocked works; at the time of their visitation they will perish.
units.Jeremiah 28:19: Jacob’s portion is not like this, for the One who formed all things is Himself his inheritance. The Lord is His name.
units.Jeremiah 28:20: You scatter instruments of war for Me. In you I will scatter nations, and from you I will remove kings.
units.Jeremiah 28:21: In you I will scatter horse and rider; in you I will scatter chariots and their riders.
units.Jeremiah 28:22: In you I will scatter young man and virgin; in you I will scatter man and woman.
units.Jeremiah 28:23: In you I will scatter shepherd and flock; in you I will scatter farmer and farmland; in you I will scatter your leaders and generals.
units.Jeremiah 28:24: I will repay Babylon and all the Chaldeans who live there for all the evils they did against Zion before your eyes, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 28:25: I am against you, ruined mountain that ruins the whole earth. I will stretch My hand against you, roll you down from the rocks, and make you like a burned mountain.
units.Jeremiah 28:26: They will certainly not take from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone, for you will be a ruin for ever, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 28:27: Raise a signal on the earth; sound a trumpet among the nations. Consecrate nations against her; give orders against her to Ararat’s kingdoms from Me and to the Ashkenazites. Set up arrow batteries against her; bring up horses against her like a multitude of locusts.

units.Jeremiah 28:29: The earth was shaken and suffered, for the Lord’s purpose rose against Babylon, to make Babylon’s land a ruin, no longer inhabited.
units.Jeremiah 28:30: Babylon’s warrior has ceased fighting; they will sit there in confinement. Their power was crushed; they became like women. Her dwellings were burned; her bars were shattered.
units.Jeremiah 28:31: Pursuer will pursue to meet pursuer, and announcer to meet announcer, to tell Babylon’s king that his city has been captured;
units.Jeremiah 28:32: from the extremity of his crossings they were taken, and their gatherings were burned with fire, and his warriors are going out.
units.Jeremiah 28:33: For thus says the Lord: The houses of Babylon’s king will be threshed like a threshing floor ready for use; a little longer, and her harvest will come.
units.Jeremiah 28:34: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon devoured me, divided me, seized me, a thin vessel. He swallowed me like a dragon, filled his belly, and drove me from my luxury.
units.Jeremiah 28:35: My toils and miseries be upon Babylon, the woman dwelling in Zion will say; my blood be upon the Chaldeans who live there, Jerusalem will say.
units.Jeremiah 28:36: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will judge your adversary and avenge you; I will lay her sea waste and dry her spring.
units.Jeremiah 28:37: Babylon will become a ruin and will not be inhabited.
units.Jeremiah 28:38: Together they were roused like lions and like lions’ cubs.
units.Jeremiah 28:39: In their heat I will give them a drink and make them drunk, so that they are stupefied and sleep an everlasting sleep and certainly do not rise, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 28:40: I will bring them down like lambs to slaughter and like rams with young goats.
units.Jeremiah 28:41: How the boast of the whole earth was captured and hunted! How Babylon became a ruin among the nations!
units.Jeremiah 28:42: The sea rose over Babylon with the sound of its waves, and she was covered.
units.Jeremiah 28:43: Her cities became a waterless and untrodden land; not one person will live there, nor will any human lodge there.
units.Jeremiah 28:44: I will exact vengeance on Babylon and bring what she swallowed out of her mouth. Nations will certainly no longer gather to her.
units.Jeremiah 28:49: And in Babylon wounded men from all the earth will fall.

units.Jeremiah 28:53: Even if Babylon rises as high as heaven and fortifies the height of her strength, those who destroy her will come from Me, says the Lord.

units.Jeremiah 28:57: He will make her leaders and wise men and generals thoroughly drunk, says the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.
units.Jeremiah 28:58: Thus says the Lord: Babylon’s wall was broadened; it will be utterly demolished, and her high gates burned. Peoples will not labor in vain, and nations will perish at the beginning.

units.Jeremiah 28:61: Jeremiah said to Seraiah: When you arrive in Babylon, you will see and read all these words,

units.Isaiah 34:1: Draw near, nations, and hear, rulers! Let the earth and those in it hear, the inhabited world and the people in it!
units.Isaiah 34:2: For the Lord’s wrath is against all nations, and anger against their number, to destroy them and hand them over to slaughter.
units.Isaiah 34:3: Their wounded and dead will be thrown out; their odor will rise, and mountains will be soaked with their blood.
units.Isaiah 34:4: Heaven will roll up like a scroll, and all the stars will fall like leaves from a vine, like leaves falling from a fig tree.
units.Isaiah 34:5: My sword became drunk in heaven. Behold, it will descend upon Idumea and upon the people of destruction, with judgment.
units.Isaiah 34:6: The Lord’s sword was filled with blood, thickened with lambs’ fat and the fat of male goats and rams, for the Lord has a sacrifice in Bosor and a great slaughter in Idumea.
units.Isaiah 34:7: The stout ones will fall with them, and rams and bulls; the earth will become drunk with blood and be filled with their fat.
units.Isaiah 34:8: For it is the Lord’s day of judgment and a year of repayment for Zion’s judgment.
units.Isaiah 34:9: Her ravines will turn to pitch, her earth to sulfur, and her land will burn like pitch
units.Isaiah 34:10: night and day. It will not be quenched for an everlasting time, and her smoke will rise upward. For generations and a long time she will be deserted.
units.Psalms 88:6: The heavens will acknowledge Thy wonders, Lord, and Thy truth in an assembly of holy ones.
units.Psalms 88:7: For who in clouds will be equaled to the Lord, and who among sons of God will be likened to the Lord?
units.Psalms 88:8: God is glorified in the council of holy ones, great and fearsome above all around Him.
units.Psalms 88:9: Lord, God of powers, who is like Thee? Thou art mighty, Lord, and Thy truth surrounds Thee.
units.Psalms 88:10: Thou rulest the sea’s might, and Thou quietest the surge of its waves.
units.Psalms 88:11: Thou didst humble a proud one like a wounded man, and with the arm of Thy power Thou didst scatter Thine enemies.
units.Psalms 88:12: The heavens are Thine, and the earth is Thine; the inhabited world and its fullness—Thou didst found them.
units.Psalms 88:13: The north and seas—Thou didst create them; Tabor and Hermon will exult in Thy name.
